description: A knowledge base reached through its gateway, over HTTP. The gateway's origin is the protocol, the host in lowercase and the port; a host that is not a host's name is refused before it is put into a URL (specs/src/session/gateway-url-cases.json).

kind.description: Discriminant: the endpoint is a gateway reached over HTTP.

host.description: The gateway's host, as a person or a discovery document gave it.

protocol.description: What the gateway is reached over.
